visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark shoulder-length hair is seated at a dark wooden table in a restaurant environment. She is wearing a black polo-style shirt decorated with large white floral prints. On her left wrist, she wears a silver smartwatch with a dark textured band. In the foreground, a large, golden-brown loaf of bread sits on a wooden serving board. The lighting is warm and amber-toned, emanating from overhead restaurant fixtures. (2) As the subject looks directly into the camera lens, a digital transition effect begins. Swirling white feathers and soft, wispy smoke-like particles emerge from the bottom and sides of the frame, gradually obscuring her torso and arms. The camera appears to zoom in slightly, focusing on her face as the particles fill the scene. (3) The environment shifts entirely to a CGI underwater setting. The woman is transformed into a mermaid character with vibrant red hair and shimmering green scales covering her tail and upper body. She wears delicate white floral jewelry on her hair and wrists. Small, translucent bubbles float around her in the teal-blue water. The lighting is cool and diffused, simulating deep-sea illumination.
